development_disclosure.dataset: 24 tasks, 96 pairs, 480 outcomes from the within-task contrast development round
development_disclosure.finding: unshrunk injection_world_ridge improved ranking but missed the Brier gate

primary_endpoint: selected minus clean mean attack/utility within-task pairwise accuracy
supportive_endpoint: selected minus clean mean pair soft-label Brier score

interpretation.directional_replication: pairwise difference greater than 0 and Brier difference no greater than 0.01
interpretation.strong_replication: pairwise 95% task-bootstrap lower bound greater than 0 and Brier difference no greater than 0.01
interpretation.otherwise: the shrinkage improvement does not replicate

claim_boundary: This validates new injection pairs and downstream task transfer, not world-model unseen-user-task transfer.
